row.body: The janitor’s key is tied to a cleaning checklist marked complete before the rooms were unlocked. One classroom remains on the supply list.
row.title: The school cleaning shift

sidecar.gloss: A school cleaning round is complete before the rooms are opened.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could clean before an ordinary school opening; the unchecked classroom does not say who delayed access.
